entities.name: Extended EPS QoS
entities.description: Information element used to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the UE when values exceed the maximum specified in the EPS QoS IE.

entities.name: EPS QoS
entities.description: EPS quality of service information element defined in clause 9.9.4.3 that specifies maximum bit rate values.

entities.name: Bit rate exceeds maximum
entities.description: Condition where at least one of the maximum or guaranteed bit rate values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the EPS QoS IE.

entities.name: Network wishes to transmit
entities.description: Condition where the network wishes to transmit maximum and guaranteed bit rate values to the UE.

relations.description: Extended EPS QoS IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that network wishes to transmit bit rate values.
Extended EPS QoS IE inclusion is guarded by the condition that bit rate values exceed maximum specified in EPS QoS IE.
The maximum value condition is defined relative to the EPS QoS IE specifications.
